subject: reasoning
question: In a code language, ‘ACID’ is written as ‘XDFE’, and ‘HAND’ is written as ‘EBKE’. How will ‘ZEST’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

‘ACID’ is written as ‘XDFE’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9caa4b758d643374b4c66a1bd49b5a2f551f1cd6924f0117c9b5b0258d5be8b0.png] 

And,

‘HAND’ is written as ‘EBKE’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd8b981ca68db1abf17ecb6a4893be07c8a21fd5d2512a069b8518b50fd31be2.png] 

Similarly,

‘ZEST’ will be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c6539762147f8afadff42d43b11b316585a5bbe4b31d12c8772c4ac9cd728a1.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
